   61      # chunk plaintext into ~4096 byte chunks, but not less than 1024 bytes in a chunk if chunking.
   62      # we do this by counting how many chunks we have and adding one.
   63      def encrypt_in_chunks(plaintext)
   64        plain_size = plaintext.bytesize
   65        number_chunks = plain_size / 4096
   66        chunk_size = plain_size / (1 + number_chunks)
   67        ciphertext_set = plaintext.scan(/.{1,#{chunk_size}}/m).map(&method(:encrypt_raw_kms))
   68        KEY_TYPE[:KMS] + ciphertext_set.map { |chunk| Base64.strict_encode64(chunk) }.to_json
   69      end

   97      def decrypt_kms(ciphertext, encryption_context)
   98        clipped_ciphertext = ciphertext.gsub(KMS_KEY_REGEX, '')
   99        ciphertext_chunks = JSON.parse(clipped_ciphertext)
  100        ciphertext_chunks.map do |chunk|
  101          decrypt_raw_kms(
  102            Base64.strict_decode64(chunk),
  103            encryption_context,
  104          )
  105        end.join('')
  106      rescue JSON::ParserError, ArgumentError => error
  107        raise EncryptionError, "Failed to parse KMS ciphertext: #{error}"
  108      end
  109  
  110      def decrypt_raw_kms(ciphertext, encryption_context)
  111        KMS_CLIENT_POOL.with do |client|
  112          client.decrypt(
  113            ciphertext_blob: ciphertext,
  114            encryption_context: encryption_context,
  115          ).plaintext
  116        end
  117      rescue Aws::KMS::Errors::InvalidCiphertextException
  118        raise EncryptionError, 'Aws::KMS::Errors::InvalidCiphertextException'
  119      end

  121      def encrypt_local(plaintext, encryption_context)
  122        KEY_TYPE[:LOCAL_KEY] + chunk_plaintext(plaintext).map do |chunk|
  123          Base64.strict_encode64(
  124            encryptor.encrypt(chunk, local_encryption_key(encryption_context)),
  125          )
  126        end.to_json
  127      end
  128  
  129      def decrypt_local(ciphertext, encryption_context)
  130        clipped_ciphertext = ciphertext.gsub(LOCAL_KEY_REGEX, '')
  131        ciphertext_chunks = JSON.parse(clipped_ciphertext)
  132        ciphertext_chunks.map do |chunk|
  133          encryptor.decrypt(
  134            Base64.strict_decode64(chunk),
  135            local_encryption_key(encryption_context),
  136          )
  137        end.join('')
  138      rescue JSON::ParserError, ArgumentError => error
  139        raise EncryptionError, "Failed to parse local ciphertext: #{error}"
  140      end
  141  
  142      def local_encryption_key(encryption_context)
  143        OpenSSL::HMAC.digest(
  144          'sha256',
  145          IdentityConfig.store.password_pepper,
  146          (encryption_context.keys + encryption_context.values).sort.join(''),
  147        )
  148      end
